_about: Expected verifier output for N023. The verifier MUST refuse the chain at spec §7 step 1 with the reason string below. Status MUST be FAIL. The version string in the reason MUST be the literal claimed bytes (`V1`), not the canonical `v2` or `v1.1` placeholders used in N009/N022.
reason: format_version "V1" not supported by this verifier (running v1)
match_rule: exact-or-syntactically-equivalent (the version string MUST be the literal claimed bytes; the verifier-running-version MUST be `v1`; whitespace and quoting around the literal MAY vary)
